name: Ulfsson
saga: Lifting half a metre of basalt over a site costs three days of the site’s own sunlight. That is the whole substrate argument and it is why the Ulfssons are never the bottleneck and never the story: the material is under everybody’s feet and the energy is overhead.

tiers.note: A second kiln banked against the night, which is fifty-eight days long.
Banking is the technology. The kilns are just kilns.
Four, and the bank outlasts the night with margin.
The margin is now the product. Nothing here is ever short.
